note: Operator-populated source manifest for U9 production-input qualification (KTD23). Release engineering must qualify every byte-level artifact here with its exact immutable source, byte size, SHA-256, provenance, approved license, and a local verify path holding the real bytes, plus the recorded offline semantic-oracle evidence and the exact opencode-ai version. Real production bytes are not in this repository, so those entries are explicitly unqualified; scripts/qualify-mc-host-production-inputs.ts propagates them into non-production evidence that requireQualificationEvidence (the U2/U6 build gate) rejects. The committed tiny synapse fixture, developer caches, mutable URLs, and placeholder hashes can never qualify.
